abi: packed little-endian 32-bit lanes; GPU lists carry a length header; records in declaration order; vectors unpadded
collection_strategy: parallel graph schedules for integer scan, sum and radix sort, stable filter and concat; other stages retain literal source order; profitability must be measured
float_contract: integer-lane binary32; round-to-nearest ties-to-even, gradual underflow, signed zero, source operation order and canonical arithmetic NaN; pass-through/negation retain payload bits

limitations: bounded 64 stages and 24 traversal depth
parallel schedules support capacities up to 256^3 elements
ordered float reductions and folds run serially
exact integer-lane binary32; canonical arithmetic NaN
feedback requires matching bounded capacities and all stages to have graph descriptors
